text: I am surrounded by references to following online platforms—YouTube, the Internet—and the repetition bares a kind of urgency, even anxiety. Inside this space, behind glass walls and shimmering screens, I sense a push and pull: the seduction of endless connectivity, yet also a quiet alienation. The exhibition about research and development makes me think of how our lives are shaped by technology, even our sense of belonging. I feel curious, but also a bit unsettled, as if I am witnessing both the construction and fragmentation of meaning in real time. There is a tension between innovation and overwhelm; I am both participant and observer, pondering where I stand in this networked world.
